name: simple-wp-helpdesk
description: Build tooling for Simple WP Helpdesk JS assets (v3.7.0+).

scripts.build: wp-scripts build --webpack-src-dir=simple-wp-helpdesk/assets/src --output-path=simple-wp-helpdesk/assets/dist toast=toast/index.js admin-inbox=admin-inbox/index.js views-settings=views-settings/index.js theme-violet=theme-violet/index.js portal-v2=portal-v2/index.js reports-v2=reports-v2/index.js
scripts.start: wp-scripts start --webpack-src-dir=simple-wp-helpdesk/assets/src --output-path=simple-wp-helpdesk/assets/dist toast=toast/index.js admin-inbox=admin-inbox/index.js views-settings=views-settings/index.js theme-violet=theme-violet/index.js portal-v2=portal-v2/index.js reports-v2=reports-v2/index.js
